human_name: Chromosome 21 short-arm rDNA + flanking segmental duplications

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 chr21 p-arm — 0 to centromere boundary (~10.9 Mb). rDNA array core at 3,108,298-5,612,715 (~2.50 Mb). Coordinates from Nurk 2022, doi:10.1126/science.abj6987.

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: HPRC v1.1 acrocentric pangenome — chr21 PHR total 3.79 Mb. Per Guarracino 2023.

copy_count_typical: ~58 rDNA copies on CHM13 hap; SST1 array on 21p11.2 in direct orientation vs chr13
architecture_note: GRCh38 chr21 p-arm is N-masked. SST1 array on 21p11.2 is in direct orientation with 13p11.2 at >99% identity (Guarracino 2023) — substrate for ectopic chr13-chr21 NAHR. rob(14;21) is the most clinically important Robertsonian translocation, causing ~5% of all Down syndrome cases (familial Down syndrome).

sst1_array.note: 21p11.2 SST1 forms an inter-chromosomal SD community with 13p11.2 and 14p11.2

robertsonian_partners: chr14 (rob(14;21) — most common cause of familial Down syndrome)

primary.note: Same constraints as chr13 — multi-position by default. chr13/21 SST1 ambiguity is the dominant challenge.

fallback_chain.name: rob_14_21_breakpoint_check
fallback_chain.trigger: long-read context suggests chimeric chr14p-chr21q chain
fallback_chain.rationale: rob(14;21) products create dicentric or fused acrocentric arms detectable in HiFi/ONT chains

primary_sources.note: Nurk S et al., Science. T2T-CHM13 v2.0. rDNA array chr21 3108298-5612715 (2.50 Mb). Note: chr21 first complete acrocentric assembly was Miga 2020 (chrX) → Logsdon 2021 (chr8) framework; chr21 itself was completed by the T2T Consortium (Nurk 2022).
Guarracino A et al., Nature. chr21 PHR = 3.79 Mb; SST1 direct vs chr13; rob(14;21) clinical context.

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups — does not cover chr21 p-arm (N-masked in hg38)
ClinGen Recurrent CNV list — Robertsonian rob(14;21), rob(13;21), rob(15;21), rob(21;22); isochromosome i(21q)
